newsitem.title: USA: Kirlin Holding Corp Q4 $0.42 sh vs $0.26.
newsitem.headline: Kirlin Holding Corp Q4 $0.42 sh vs $0.26.

text.p: "We are proud to announce our 1996 earnings," David 0. Lindner, Chairman and CEO said. "In the past year, we have made a number of enhancements within our infrastructure which have strengthened an already sound foundation. These improvements will allow us to offer new opportunities, and we are very enthusiastic about the firm's future," Lindner added.

"Net income and revenues for the current year rose by 86.7% and 61.7%, respectively, as compared to 1995. In addition, our earnings per share rose to $.42, an increase of over 61%. In 1997, Kirlin will continue its commitment to aggressively search for investment opportunities which provide our customers with the best chance to succeed in the marketplace," he concluded.

Kirlin Holding Corp is a holding company engaged in securities brokerage, securities trading, and investment and merchant banking activities through its operating subsidiary, Kirlin Securities, Inc. Kirlin Securities is a full-service retail-oriented brokerage firm, specializing in the trading and sale of fixed income securities with an emphasis on corporate and municipal bonds, government and government agency securities, private placements, mutual funds, and equity securities. Recently, the firm instituted a Managed Asset Portfolio Program (MAPP), a detailed plan designed to help investors develop and achieve any financial objective.

Kirlin Securities is registered as a broker-dealer and investment advisor with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and is a member firm of the National Association of Securities Dealers (NASD) and the Securities Investor Protection Corporation (SIPC). The company's common stock trades on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market tier of the Nasdaq Stock Market under the symbol KILN. SOURCE Kirlin Holding Corp.
